Tap: Attaches 「Harmonic Series」 to the target for 25s and deals Lakshana DMG. When Akane Rin performs a Basic Attack, the 「Harmonic Series」 resonates, conducting that Basic Attack over a long distance to the attached target with a 32.5% DMG Ratio bonus.

When Akane Rin performs a Basic Attack, the 「Sound Domain」 resonates, conducting that Basic Attack to the 「Sound Domain」 and dealing 1 instance of Basic Attack DMG to all enemies within, granting that conducted Basic Attack an additional 36% DMG bonus.
Only one of 「Harmonic Series」 or 「Sound Domain」 can exist on the field; a newly established state replaces the old one. Both cast modes share the same cooldown, and the state can be chosen again once the cooldown ends.
When 「Chord Energy」 reaches 30 and a valid 「Harmonic Series」 or 「Sound Domain」 exists on the field, Enhanced Skill 「Synchronized Resonance」 can be cast, producing an effect based on the current state:
「Harmonic Series」: Deals 1 instance of high single-target Lakshana DMG to the attached target.
「Sound Domain」: Deals 1 instance of enhanced spread Lakshana DMG to enemies within.
Hitting with the Enhanced Skill consumes 30 「Chord Energy」; missing consumes none. The original 「Harmonic Series」 or 「Sound Domain」 remains, and its remaining duration is not refreshed.
The Enhanced Skill has no separate cooldown and does not affect the cooldowns of normal skills.
When no 「Harmonic Series」 or 「Sound Domain」 exists on the field, the Enhanced Skill cannot be cast; a normal skill must first be used to establish a state.
